# SOP-P3-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03  
Related: ECN-2026-006, MM-P3-L1-IH03, SB-1027

1. Purpose
   1.1. Define safe steps to change over Hot Forge line tools and process settings between part families.

2. Preconditions
   2.1. All operators must have completed line-specific training and hold current permits per ECN-2026-006.  
   2.2. Confirm production schedule authorisation and tool availability.  
   2.3. Verify maintenance clearances on EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03.

3. PPE
   3.1. Wear heat-resistant gloves, face shield, hearing protection and safety shoes.  
   3.2. Use insulated sleeves when interacting with EQ-P3-L1-IH03 components. Refer to MM-P3-L1-IH03 for heater-specific PPE notes.

4. Changeover steps
   4.1. Stop feed and lockout/tagout following SB-1027 procedures.  
   4.2. Drain and secure hydraulic lines on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 per manufacturer guidance. Replace lubricant with CFW-LUB-927 and document the change in maintenance log.  
   4.3. Remove and install dies on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 using lift-assist tools; inspect die interfaces for wear.  
   4.4. Adjust scrap conveyor and shot-blast settings on EQ-P3-L1-SB02 to match new die geometry.  
   4.5. On EQ-P3-L1-IH03, confirm induction heater setpoint and measure billet condition. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C. Record measured value against target and tag any deviation for corrective action per ECN-2026-006.  
   4.6. Perform cold trial sequence without billet heating to verify mechanical alignment, then perform heated trial with operator supervision. Record all observations in the lot changeover sheet.

5. Acceptance criteria
   5.1. Dies secure, lubricant CFW-LUB-927 installed, conveyors adjusted, and measured billet reaches the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C in trial run.  
   5.2. No safety holds or tool interlocks active; quality samples within acceptance.

6. Sign-off
   6.1. Changeover completed by: ____________________  
   6.2. Line supervisor: ____________________  
   6.3. Maintenance representative (if CFW-LUB-927 fitted): ____________________  

References: ECN-2026-006; MM-P3-L1-IH03; SB-1027
